CHECK BURST CS-asm-fg-v4-mist — assemble the cliffside FOREGROUND canvas from 17 outpainted chunks with minimum-error seams, then composite the painted MIST pass over the lower cliff faces (Matt R-C3-48/54-60/66, v4.1 geometry). REPORT ONLY. task_id "CS-asm-fg-v4-mist".

Inputs (read-only): /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-guides-v4/chunks_v4.json (paint_order: each chunk's index [cx,cy], origin_px, files; canvas 5376×4096; chunk 1536×1024; step 1280×768); painted chunks /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-v4-<cx>_<cy>/chunk_<cx>_<cy>.png (flat #00ff00 = void) — where a re-drive directory CS-v4-<cx>_<cy>-r1/ exists use it instead of the original; per-chunk masks /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-guides-v4/chunk_<cx>_<cy>_mask.png; the full-canvas DEPTH map /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-guides-v4/ortho_canvas_v4_depth_mm.png (uint16 mm below rim; 65535 = not foreground) and mask /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-guides-v4/ortho_canvas_v4_mask.png. Frozen tool /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/gates/matte.py (extract, edge_mode='clamp'). python glue with PIL/numpy/scipy; no new tool files; work in RAM carefully (the canvas is 5376×4096 RGBA).

STEP 1 — per chunk: RGBA = clamp-matte of the painted chunk; alpha restricted to that chunk's mask dilated by 6 px.
STEP 2 — composite in paint_order onto a transparent 5376×4096 canvas. For each chunk, inside every overlap with pixels already placed, cut along a MINIMUM-ERROR path (cost = mean |RGB| between existing and new where both are opaque; where only one is opaque it wins; DP ±1 px per step; vertical path for left overlaps, horizontal for top overlaps; a corner square goes to the lower-cost side), feather ±3 px. Record per seam: chunk pair, path mean cost, p95.
STEP 3 — BASE: the STEP 2 canvas with alpha from the matte ONLY (NO depth fade at all).
STEP 4 — MIST SOURCES (Matt: cliff undersides must not be transparent; R-C3-60/63/66): eight mist-pass chunks, each the SAME chunk grid position as the v4 chunk: 2_1, 3_1, 2_2 from /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-mist2-<k>/mist_<k>.png; 3_2, 2_3, 3_3, 2_4, 3_4 from /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-mist2-<k>-ns/mist_<k>.png. RGBA_k = clamp matte of each (#00ff00 → transparent).
STEP 5 — MIST ZONE per chunk k (recompute exactly): dep = uint16 /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-guides-v4/chunk_<k>_depth.png; face = (dep != 65535) & (dep > 9000); below = OR over shifts s = 1, 7, 13, … ≤ 180 of face shifted DOWN by s rows; zone_k = binary_closing(face | (below & (dep == 65535)), iterations 4). Level mist region M = union of zone_k placed at chunk origins, then dilated by 48 px (billows).
STEP 6 — MIST COMPOSITE: per chunk weight w_k = wx·wy, where wx ramps linearly 0→1 over the first 256 columns if the chunk to its LEFT is in the eight-chunk set (else 1) and 1→0 over the last 256 columns if the chunk to its RIGHT is in the set (else 1); wy likewise with the chunks ABOVE/BELOW. Premultiplied weighted average of the RGBA_k over covering chunks → MIST (RGBA). Region factor r = 1 inside M, falling smoothly to 0 over 24 px outside M (distance-based). FINAL = MIST with its alpha multiplied by r, composited OVER BASE (premultiplied), straight alpha out.
STEP 7 — CHECKS: (a) pixels of the canvas depth map with 9000 < depth < 65535 whose FINAL alpha < 0.95 (count + bbox list of connected groups ≥ 400 px) — these would be see-through rock; (b) mean |FINAL − BASE| RGB outside M (must be ~0; report); (c) seam stats as before.
STEP 8 — OUTPUTS: out/foreground.png (5376×4096 RGBA), out/foreground_preview_1344x1024.png (over #3a3f4a), out/mist_region_overlay.png (preview with M outlined in cyan, 1344×1024), out/seethrough_crops.png (up to 4 full-res 640×640 crops of the largest STEP 7a groups, over magenta; or a note if none), out/checks.json, out/summary.txt ≤ 14 lines. No image_gen. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used 0. Deliver within 14 minutes.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-asm-fg-v4-mist"; images []; files: every out/ file with sha256; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
